title: Breaking the Group Size Barrier: Parameter-Efficient Group Dance Generation with Chain-of-Dancers
title_zh: 突破群体规模限制：基于“舞者链”的参数高效群体舞蹈生成

paragraphs.en: 本文提出ChainDance框架，通过链式分解每个舞者条件分布，实现不同群组大小的可扩展性舞蹈生成，同时保持舞者身份的独立性。 Group dance generation aims to synthesize coordinated multi-dancer choreography from music, with broad applications in animation and interactive content creation. This task requires modeling dense inter-person dependencies to ensure spatial coordination, while naturally preserving individual dancer identities. Existing approaches model all dancers jointly with end-to-end transformers, which tie the architecture to a fixed group size and entangle per-dancer identities across frames. We propose ChainDance, a scalable framework that reformulates group dance generation as a Chain-of-Dancers: a sequential decomposition over per-dancer conditional distributions, allowing a single model to scale across variable group sizes without retraining and naturally preserving per-dancer identity. Built on a frozen single-dancer diffusion backbone, ChainDance introduces two lightweight modules: a Role-Aware Text Encoder (RATE) for per-dancer semantic conditioning, and a Group-Aware Motion Encoder (GAME) that aggregates previously generated dancers via a distance-weighted graph convolutional network, and incorporates a training-free noise optimization procedure at inference time to enforce global spatial coherence. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChainDance achieves state-of-the-art motion quality and group coordination while structurally preserving per-dancer identity, with $3$-$4\times$ fewer parameters and requiring $3$-$6\times$ less training time compared to prior approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了ChainDance框架，通过链式分解每位舞者的条件分布，实现了不同群组规模下可扩展的舞蹈生成，同时保持了舞者身份的独立性。群舞生成旨在从音乐中合成协调的多舞者编舞，在动画和互动内容创作中有广泛应用。 这项任务需要建模密集的人际依赖关系以确保空间协调性，同时自然地保留每位舞者的个体身份。 现有方法使用端到端Transformer对所有舞者进行联合建模，这使架构被固定为特定群组规模，并导致各帧之间舞者身份的相互纠缠。 我们提出了ChainDance，一个可扩展的框架，它将群舞生成重新表述为“舞者链”：即对每位舞者的条件分布进行序列分解，使得单个模型无需重新训练即可适应不同规模的群组，并自然地保留每位舞者的身份特征。 ChainDance基于一个冻结的单舞者扩散模型主干，引入了两个轻量级模块：用于每位舞者语义条件输入的“角色感知文本编码器”（RATE），以及通过距离加权图卷积网络聚合先前生成的舞者动作的“群组感知运动编码器”（GAME）；此外，它在推理阶段引入了一种无需训练的噪声优化流程，以强制实现全局空间连贯性。 在AIOZ-GDance上的实验表明，ChainDance在保持每位舞者身份特征的结构完整性的同时，实现了当前最先进的动作质量和群组协调性，且参数数量比先前的方法减少了$3$-$4\times$，训练时间也缩短了$3$-$6\times$。
